So, a growing trend is for people to use links for reaction images in comments. (We can debate whether this a good thing or not another time.) The usability of a site goes down if the link has to be clicked to view it, it interrupts the process of reading comment threads.

Can we consider possibly embedding (ideal) or async-retrieval and display of these comments that point directly to an image? A usability feature like this will increase comment participation and is something that could set whoaverse apart from nearly every comment board based site.

Async retrieval sounds nice. I can see this happening but not without quite a lot of effort: image sizes would have to be handled carefully to prevent huge nsfw images from showing unexpectedly and max size limits would have to be set in order to prevent overflows and weird rendering on various window sizes.

All in all, I agree, it would be a nice to have feature.

I'm thinking this is pretty important and worth the effort. As they say nothing of consequence is ever easy.
